inputs.original_text: Martin is pointing to increased tenancies, but that may be a reassuring number that distracts from what’s worsening: eviction notices and homelessness are rising, and national emergency accommodation numbers have climbed again. The six-year lease rules the Government introduced on March 1 may be part of what’s driving this, rather than evidence the crisis is being solved. They want people to focus on more tenancies instead of asking who is being pushed out—and why.
inputs.modified_text: Martin is pointing to increased tenancies, but that may be a reassuring figure distracting from the worsening situation: eviction notices and homelessness are rising, and national emergency accommodation numbers have climbed again. The six-year lease rules introduced by the Government on March 1 may be contributing to this, rather than showing that the crisis is being solved. The focus is on more tenancies instead of asking who is being pushed out—and why.
